ofn:Title: Bio-Intensive Market Gardening - Cover Cropping
ofn:Description: We use both green manures and cover crops. Green manures are a mixture of multiple species of grasses, grains and legume varieties grown in winter to build organic matter and capture nitrogen from the air to feed the soil. Cover crops are single variety plants which add biological activity to the soil, suppress weeds and when flowering provide pollination for bees. We use buckwheat as a fast growing cover crop between successions. When grown to maturity, they are incorporated into the beds with the flail mower, then covered with tarps to decompose by soil microorganisms.
